profile.headline: Software Engineer at Best Buy
profile.summary:
For nearly 3 years I wandered the planet, wrote Go code, built SQL databases, solved problems, explored various cities, cultures, and cafes. This new chapter has me settled down in Minneapolis with a great team working for a company that continues to impress me. At work I deal primarily with JavaScript/React/React Native/GraphQL-Apollo Client and at home I work with Svelte/Capacitor/PostgreSQL/Hasura on Vercel/nhost/Cloudflare with some Go for some services on Azure.

Outside of my personal projects, I'm pulling espresso shots, spinning some records, looking out at space, kicking back with something to read, planning my next trip, and getting friends and neighbors to join in on whatever's brewing next.

positions.title: Backend/Frontend Developer
positions.description: I write web apps. Currently utilizing Go, PostgreSQL, Dgraph, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Svelte to create them.

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist - Blues (Tier 2) Backup/Recovery
positions.description:
Supported Tivoli Storage Manager for over 10 accounts, 25+ servers, and thousands of clients
Supported HP Data Protector, Symantec Backup Exec, and Arcserve backup solutions
Utilized Maximo, Impact, Remedy, and Manage Now ticketing systems
Wrote scripts for automation and simplification (python, bash, ksh, perl)
Troubleshot and drove to resolution DB2 and Oracle issues in relation to backups
Enjoyed the daily puzzles related to Linux/AIX/Windows clients
Resolved 100% of tickets within SLA deadlines.

positions.title: System Adminstrator
positions.description:
Built and maintained FreeNAS based network attached storage system for field offices		
Built and maintained OpenBSD based VPN gateway				
Maintained Cisco UC520 IP Phone System and VPN			
Maintained CardAccess 3000, Active Directory, and EMC2 backup server
Provisioned and managed systems for staff of 24 and provided 24/7 phone support

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
Provisioned and managed systems for staff and provided 24/7 phone support
Built and maintained FreeNAS based network attached storage system
Software training

positions.title: Assistant, Model, Tech Support
positions.description:
As independent contractor with Old City Hall Gallery I took on many roles.
Fine art custom framing
Modeling
Hard drive recovery			
Gardening
Hardware upgrades
General construction and gallery maintenance 						
Software install, updates, training on (Mac OS X, Windows, Linux, Blackberry, Android, IOS).
General internet security awareness training.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Gnomads was a place of Coffee, Tea, Chocolate, Food, Live Music, Movies, Art Gallery, Hackerspace, Board Gaming Hub, Knitting Scene, Meeting Place.

With 4 employees, I was involved in and driving nearly all aspects of such a small business.
